scripts.build:staging: tsc -b && vite build --mode staging --outDir dist-staging --emptyOutDir && node --input-type=module -e "import { copyFileSync, existsSync } from 'node:fs'; if (!existsSync('dist-staging/staging.html')) throw new Error('Vite staging entry staging.html is missing'); copyFileSync('dist-staging/staging.html', 'dist-staging/index.html'); if (!existsSync('dist-staging/index.html')) throw new Error('Render root entry index.html is missing');"
